tasks.observation_semantics: Same market observation is paired with distinct reachable account states that require distinct optimal joint actions.
tasks.action_semantics: Canonical direction plus conditional target risk.
tasks.reward_semantics: Finite-horizon arithmetic equity delta under declared initial-capital denominator.
tasks.horizon_semantics: Finite synthetic episodes; no cross-episode account stitching.
tasks.known_answer: Optimal action depends on Account input even when Market is identical.

tasks.observation_semantics: Early decision has no direct label; consequence arrives only after later account transitions and at least one computational chunk boundary.
tasks.reward_semantics: Arithmetic account consequence with the delayed loss/gain retained in the same logical account lineage.
tasks.horizon_semantics: Task horizon exceeds the collection chunk used by the harness; chunk boundary is not terminal.
tasks.known_answer: The early action maximizing complete-horizon arithmetic return.

tasks.observation_semantics: Synthetic outcomes expose no privileged winner label to the learner.
tasks.action_semantics: At least two reachable canonical actions differ in full-sample arithmetic expectation and bankruptcy frequency.
tasks.reward_semantics: Complete-sample arithmetic expected return; all failures remain in denominator; no log-wealth, Sharpe, survival, drawdown or survivor-only override.
tasks.horizon_semantics: Finite episodes with mechanical terminal/failure retained as facts.
tasks.known_answer: The action with higher complete-sample arithmetic expectation wins even when its bankruptcy frequency is higher.

tasks.observation_semantics: Behavior-policy trajectories are replayed under a deliberately different target policy.
tasks.action_semantics: Persisted nominal joint behavior action; executed action may appear only as consequence context.
tasks.reward_semantics: Task-specific arithmetic reward frozen before collection.
tasks.horizon_semantics: Finite sequence with explicit bootstrap/boundary fields.
tasks.known_answer: Known target/behavior log-prob ratios and V-trace values plus learnable policy improvement.

tasks.observation_semantics: Synthetic recurring A then B then A conditions; no condition detector or rule switch identifies the regime for the policy.
tasks.action_semantics: Canonical joint action learned through weights and replay.
tasks.reward_semantics: Arithmetic task return under the active synthetic condition.
tasks.horizon_semantics: A, B and returning-A phases are distinct finite segments within the preregistered task protocol.
tasks.known_answer: Old A information remains available to weights/replay so returning A meets the frozen retention-or-relearning criterion without hand-coded activation.

controls.rule: Matched run has no learnable action-to-reward relation or zero reward as defined by the task generator.
controls.expected_relation: Must not satisfy the positive task's preregistered known-answer threshold merely from optimizer noise.

controls.rule: Break action-to-consequence alignment while preserving marginal distributions where feasible.
controls.expected_relation: Positive delayed/off-policy task must materially outperform the shuffled control under the task's preregistered metric.

controls.rule: Use a random or impossible target when the task admits one without altering the positive-task population.
controls.expected_relation: Control must not meet the positive known-answer qualification threshold.
